visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a white long-sleeved button-down shirt and a man in a blue blazer wearing a white Guy Fawkes mask stand against a plain white wall. Small white particles fall from the top of the frame, simulating light snowfall. The woman looks upwards with a joyful, expectant expression. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the woman wearing a pink shirt, holding a black hairbrush to her head and scraping it vigorously to create white flakes. A boy in a beige hoodie and glasses is shown sitting in a living room setting, looking at the scene with a bored expression while holding a remote control. (3) Back at the white wall, the woman is now heavily covered in white particles on her hair and shoulders. She looks distressed and panicked. The man in the mask remains perfectly still. Large colorful text overlays in Chinese appear around them. (4) Transition to a brightly lit retail pharmacy environment (Cosmed). The woman is now wearing a white sleeveless dress, posing energetically with white and green Cetaphil product bottles. She points to her clear skin and smiles broadly at the camera. (5) A montage follows showing the woman in various travel locations: running on a white sand beach in a red bikini, standing in a lush green forest, and jumping into a pool. She is then seen back in an indoor setting, demonstrating the application of cleanser, toner, and serum to her face. (6) The woman pushes a black shopping cart through the store aisles, twirling her dress and raising her arms in excitement. She interacts with the camera, making various facial expressions. The video concludes with a close-up of her laughing with her mouth wide open.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Whimsical, light-hearted orchestral background music begins with a bright piano melody. A female voice speaks with a high pitch and an excited, fairytale-like tone. A sharp mechanical 'click' SFX marks a transition to a male child's voice that sounds authoritative and critical. (2) A comedic 'whoosh' SFX and a record scratch lead into a scene with quieter ambient room tone. The female voice becomes sheepish and apologetic, followed by a series of soft percussive thuds representing the 'dandruff' flakes. (3) An energetic, high-tempo electronic pop track (approx. 128 BPM) takes over the audio bed. The female narrator delivers a rapid-fire, enthusiastic pitch about skincare. This section is punctuated by multiple high-frequency 'ding' and 'pop' digital sound effects aligned with text overlays. (4) The music swells as the female voice begins singing a parody of 'Let It Go' in a dramatic, high-arousal style with heavy vibrato. This is followed by a sudden burst of rhythmic laughter and a final high-pitched shout. The audio concludes with a clean hard cut to silence.
